title: Can You Actually Grow Taller?
mascot_sheet: Character sheet of Bendy, a sleepy 2D cartoon cat, fluffy soft grey fur, oversized rounded square-ish head, sleepy half-closed black cartoon eyes, tiny pink nose, cute whiskers, lazy slouching stance, thick bold outlines, minimal flat colors, front view, plain white background
voice: Fast, energetic, humorous and playful tone
music: Upbeat bouncy cartoon acoustic guitar and marimba beat at 125 BPM, low volume under voice

scenes.bg: Vibrant warm yellow backdrop with faint radiating comic burst lines
scenes.pose: Bendy the grey cartoon cat slouched flat like a melted puddle of dough, chin on the floor, looking up miserably with droopy half-closed eyes

props.prompt: Cartoon wooden height ruler chart showing low height marks with funny sad sticker

scenes.vo: First, fix that melted spine posture!
scenes.bg: Pastel teal backdrop with minimal vertical rising bubbles
scenes.pose: Bendy suddenly snapping upright with wide alert eyes, puffing out chest in an exaggerated military salute

props.prompt: Glowing cartoon neon straight spine arrow icon pointing upwards

scenes.vo: Hang daily to decompress your joints.
scenes.bg: Soft light blue sky background with two tiny flat clouds
scenes.pose: Bendy hanging by both front paws from a pull-up bar, body stretched long like elastic noodle cat, smiling contentedly

props.prompt: Horizontal metal pull-up bar fixture with yellow safety grips

scenes.vo: Sleep eight hours so growth thrives.
scenes.bg: Cozy deep purple night background with tiny twinkling cartoon stars
scenes.pose: Bendy curled comfortably on a fluffy white pillow, snoozing peacefully with small cartoon Zzz bubbles floating up

props.prompt: Floating digital cartoon clock showing '8-10 HRS' in glowing green letters

scenes.vo: Fuel up with milk and greens.
scenes.bg: Fresh lime green solid background with sunny yellow circle pattern
scenes.pose: Bendy licking lips enthusiastically, holding a giant cartoon fork ready to feast

props.prompt: Tall glass of fresh milk with calcium sparkles
Crisp green cartoon broccoli head with shiny sparkle effects

scenes.vo: Don't fall for silly stretching racks!
scenes.bg: Pale warm orange comic background with jagged shock lines
scenes.pose: Bendy comically tied to an absurd medieval wooden stretching machine with dizzy spiral eyes and comedic panicked expression

props.prompt: Big red cartoon 'NO!' ban sign with a thick red cross through it

scenes.vo: Now stand tall at full height!
scenes.bg: Bright golden yellow background with bold upward speed arrows
scenes.pose: Bendy standing proudly upright on hind legs, tall and sleek with paws on hips, winking and flashing a thumbs-up

props.prompt: Golden gleaming cartoon crown floating proudly above head

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.
scenes.bg: Clean vibrant royal blue background with subtle white geometric grid
scenes.pose: Bendy standing tall, holding up an oversized smartphone displaying a colorful growth routine dashboard

props.prompt: Stylized app badge logo of TallPlan with a rising green growth chart arrow
